# Nordic Perspective

> > A comprehensive resource on Nordic and Scandinavian life, culture, travel, and history covering Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland, Iceland, and the Faroe Islands.

Nordic Perspective explores Viking heritage, Norse mythology, modern expat living, and cultural traditions across the five Nordic countries. The site features guides on topics ranging from Younger Futhark runes to practical advice for relocating to Scandinavia.

## Key Topics

- Vikings
- Sweden
- Denmark
- Norway
- Finland
- Iceland
- Faroe Islands
- Younger Futhark
- Old Norse
- Nordic culture
- Scandinavia
- Viking runes
- Norse mythology
- Expat life
- Nordic noir

- [Nordic Perspective – Nordic life, travel, culture, people, facts & history](https://nordicperspective.com): Homepage covering Nordic culture, travel, and history across five countries
